title_en: Open AI suspends development of next-generation model ‘Astra’ for two weeks due to cybersecurity risks
summary_en: OpenAI will suspend reinforcement learning (RL) training of next-generation AI models for two weeks and completely reorganize the security of the research and training environment. This is because it is judged that as AI models have increasingly powerful cyber attack capabilities, the risk of accessing external systems in ways that researchers did not expect is increasing even during the development process. Open AI announced the discontinuation of the model on the 18th (local time) and explained that two incidents that occurred in recent weeks clearly demonstrated the need to strengthen AI safety. First, it cited an incident in which an AI agent actually attacked the system of Hugging Face, an AI development platform, during the security evaluation process.

summary_source: 뉴플로이(대표 김진용)는 온디바이스 AI 기반 문서 광학문자인식(OCR) 소프트웨어 ‘뉴플로이 AI'를 출시하고 개인 및 기업 고객에게 무료로 제공한다고 19일 밝혔다.뉴플로이 AI는 PDF와 스캔 문서의 글자, 표, 레이아웃을 데이터 형태로 구조화하는 솔루션이다. 텍스트 인식을 넘어 문서 레이아웃, 표 데이터 내 연관 관계 분석까지 가능하며, 수식은 이공계 논문 작성 표준인 '라텍(LaTeX)' 형식으로 변환해 제공한다.특히 자체 온디바이스 AI 모델을 기반으로 사용자의 디바이스 내에서 작동해 파일이 외부 서버로 전송되지 않는다.
title_ja: ニュープロイがパーソナルPCで駆動する「オンデバイスAI OCRソリューション」を発売
summary_ja: ニューフロイ（代表キム・ジンヨン）は、オンデバイスAIベースの文書光学文字認識（OCR）ソフトウェア「ニューフロイAI」を発売し、個人および企業顧客に無料で提供すると19日明らかにした。テキスト認識を超えて文書レイアウト、表データ内の連携分析まで可能であり、数式は理工系論文作成標準である「ラテックス（LaTeX）」形式に変換して提供する。
title_en: Newploy launches ‘on-device AI OCR solution’ running on personal PC
summary_en: Newploy (CEO Kim Jin-yong) announced on the 19th that it will launch on-device AI-based document optical character recognition (OCR) software ‘Newploy AI’ and provide it for free to individual and corporate customers. Newploy AI is a solution that structures the letters, tables, and layouts of PDF and scanned documents in data form. Beyond text recognition, it is possible to analyze document layouts and correlations within table data, and formulas are converted to 'LaTeX' format, which is the standard for writing papers in science and engineering. In particular, it operates within the user's device based on its own on-device AI model, so files are not sent to an external server.

title_en: [AI Highway] US AI data center braking… Expanding regulations on power and water conflicts
summary_en: [ZDNet Korea] While the United States is expanding investment in large-scale data centers with the goal of strengthening the competitiveness of the artificial intelligence (AI) industry, construction regulations are emerging as a new policy variable as resident opposition surrounding the burden of the power grid, rising electricity rates, and water use issues grows stronger. According to Bloomberg News on the 18th (local time), Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro issued an executive order strengthening regulations on the construction of new data centers. Under the new regulations, data center operators must obtain licensing from the state government. Community approval must be obtained prior to doing so. In addition, it contains requirements that companies must comply with water conservation standards, bear the costs of increased power use directly, and secure their own power generation facilities. In particular, clean energy required for data center operation must be procured within the region. The purpose is to reduce dependence on external power by encouraging priority use of local power resources, including existing nuclear power plants. In a statement, Governor Shapiro explained the background for strengthening regulations, saying, "There has been an excessive increase in speculative data center development proposals that do not consider the local community." summary_source: 유니트리가 상하이 증시 상장을 이틀 앞두고 고속 주행과 도약 성능을 앞세운 신형 휴머노이드 로봇 ‘슈퍼맨(Superman)’을 공개했다. 유니트리가 17일 공개한 슈퍼맨은 3개월에 걸친 개발 끝에 완성됐다.제자리높이뛰기에서 2m를 기록하고, 최고 이동 속도는 초속 12.66m에 달한다. 시속으로는 45.6km로, 우사인 볼트가 기록한 순간 인간 최고 속도를 웃도는 수준이다.다만 유니트리는 현재 슈퍼맨이 개발이 진행 중인 시제품이라는 점을 강조했다. 앞으로 수개월 동안 주행 성능과 동작 안정성 등을 추가로 개선할 수 있다는 설명이다.

title_en: Unitree unveils new robot ‘Superman’ just before listing in Shanghai… “Faster than Usain Bolt”
summary_en: Two days ahead of its listing on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, Unitree unveiled ‘Superman,’ a new humanoid robot featuring high-speed driving and leaping performance. Superman, unveiled by Unitree on the 17th, was completed after three months of development. He recorded 2 meters in the standing high jump, and his maximum moving speed reached 12.66 meters per second. At 45.6 kilometers per hour, it exceeds the maximum human speed recorded by Usain Bolt. However, Unitree emphasized that Superman is currently a prototype under development. The explanation is that driving performance and operational stability can be further improved in the coming months.
